name: Grantham Foundation for the Protection of the Environment
program: Climate change grants and investments (clean energy, agriculture)
page_reason: The Grantham Foundation reviews proposals by invitation only (contact page, 2026-11-12) and publishes no call list, deadline, feed or API. The Grants & Investments page lists thematic priorities and already-funded grantees and investees, not open calls. The page is watched, and a new priority, grantee list or investment area shows up as a page change for review.
collect_note: No public call list exists: the foundation works by invitation only and does not consider proposals with indirect costs above 10%. The Grants & Investments page is watched and any change is flagged for review, so a future open call would appear there or on the thinking page.
